item.title: OakDOT goes after tens of millions of dollars in road safety grants
item.description: OakDOT goes after tens of millions of dollars in road safety grants The city transportation department will seek at least $75 million in state, federal, and county funds to make 73rd Ave., West Grand Ave., and Hegenberger Rd. safer.

item.title: Oakland school board calls special meeting to avert teachers’ strike
item.description: Oakland school board calls special meeting to avert teachers’ strike Hoping to reach a deal, OUSD and OEA are inching closer on compensation numbers.

item.title: Can landlords raise the rent when roommates move out in Oakland?
item.description: Can landlords raise the rent when roommates move out in Oakland? An Adams Point tenant alleges their landlord broke local rental laws by raising their rent 27%.

item.title: Oakland police make ‘significant dent’ in disciplinary hearing backlog
item.description: Oakland police make ‘significant dent’ in disciplinary hearing backlog OPD reported a 73% reduction in pending Skelly hearings in a 15-month period. But questions linger over who should run the process.

item.title: What to know if Oakland teachers go on strike
item.description: What to know if Oakland teachers go on strike Oakland teachers voted to authorize a strike last Friday. Pressure is rising for OUSD to come to an agreement with their union, the OEA, while facing a looming $100 million deficit.

item.title: The Barbary and Gus’s no longer serving, plus the final weekend for Tiger’s Taproom
item.description: The Barbary and Gus’s no longer serving, plus the final weekend for Tiger’s Taproom A running list of restaurants that have recently closed in Berkeley, Oakland, Richmond, and beyond.

item.title: Deadly lookalikes
item.description: Deadly lookalikes A surge in toxic mushroom growth after heavy rain has disproportionately sickened Spanish-speaking and immigrant communities across California, with the heaviest concentration in the Bay Area.

item.title: Alameda County looks for $10M to stave off health care layoffs and program closures
item.description: Alameda County looks for $10M to stave off health care layoffs and program closures Alameda Health System workers and union leaders said their units are already stretched too thin and criticized administrators.

item.description: Oakland sports calendar: A celebration for Alysa Liu; Roots and Falcons season openers Other events include Oakland Ballers open tryouts, the Oakland 68s Fans Fest, and championship matches for Oakland high school soccer and basketball.

item.title: OUSD board approves 421 staff layoffs
item.description: OUSD board approves 421 staff layoffs Less than a year out of state receivership and facing the threat of a strike, the Oakland school district’s finances are stretched thin.
